about:
Magnum Metals operates from Nettleton, Mississippi. The company was established over three decades ago, building on 30 years of industry experience and a team with a collective 150 years of expertise. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures pre-engineered steel buildings, premium metal panels, pole barns, and tube-frame carports. It handles every aspect of production in-house, maintaining direct control over quality and process efficiency. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Magnum Metals serves residential, commercial, industrial, and structural customers across the Southeast. Its products are used in projects ranging from custom home metalwork to large-scale industrial fabrication.

The company distinguishes itself as the only Mississippi firm that manages all production stages internally, allowing complete oversight of quality and turnaround. This integrated approach is cited as the foundation of its reputation for reliability.
